evidence.title: Mobile App Animation: 12 Patterns Every Designer Should Study

name: Mobile App Animation: 12 Patterns Every Designer Should Study
summary: Blog article walking through 12 mobile app animation patterns, from launch screens and onboarding to loaders, success and error states.
description: A design article on mobile UI animation: it covers twelve patterns — launch screen, onboarding, login, navigation, explainer, loading page, animated logo, success state, micro-animations, buttons, icons and error states — with examples for each and a short FAQ on performance and platform differences.
